an10.172:1.1: adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo, dhammo ca,
an10.172:1.3: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti
an10.172:1.5: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an10.172:2.1: atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.172:2.2: idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.172:2.5: adhammaṃ ca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho tathā paṭipajjitabbanti.
an10.172:2.6: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
an10.172:3.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahā kaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:3.3: pahoti cāyasmā mahā kaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:3.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahā kaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahā kaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:3.5: yathā no āyasmā mahākaccāno vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmāti.
an10.172:4.1: atha kho te bhikkhu yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahā kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
an10.172:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu āyasmantaṃ mahā kaccānaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an10.172:5.1: “idaṃ kho no āvuso kaccāna bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.172:5.4: adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabbanti”.
an10.172:6.1: tesaṃ no āvuso acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.172:6.2: “idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho.
an10.172:6.3: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo, yathā attho,
an10.172:6.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā”ti
an10.172:7.2: ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahā kaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:7.3: pahoti cāyasmā mahā kaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:7.4: yannūnamayaṃ yenāyasmā mahā kaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahā kaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma.
an10.172:7.5: yathā no āyasmā mahākaccāno vyākarissati, tathā naṃ dhāressāmā”ti.
an10.172:8.1: seyyāthāpi āvuso puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkammeva mūlaṃ, atikkamma khandhaṃ, sākhāpalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya,
an10.172:8.2: evaṃ sampadamidaṃ. āyasmantaṃ satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etamatthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha.
an10.172:8.3: sohāvuso bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati. cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
an10.172:8.4: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi yaṃ tumhe bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha.
an10.172:8.5: yathā kho bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthā ti.
an10.172:9.1: addhā āvuso kaccāna bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhu bhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammassāmī tathāgato.
an10.172:9.2: so ceva panetassa kālo ahosi: yaṃ mayaṃ bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma,
an10.172:9.3: yathā no bhagavā vyākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma,
an10.172:9.4: apicāyasmā mahā kaccāno satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito, sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
an10.172:9.5: pahoticāyasmā mahā kaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:10.2: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
an10.172:11.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.172:11.2: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthaṃ ca viditvā atthañca yathā dhammo, yathā attho,
an10.172:12.1: katamo cāvuso adhammo, katamo ca dhammo,
an10.172:12.2: katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho:
an10.172:12.5: ye ca pāṇātipāta paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.172:12.6: pāṇātipātā veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:13.3: yeca adinnādānapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:13.4: adinnādānā veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:14.3: ye ca kāmesu micchācārapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.172:14.4: kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:15.3: yeca musāvāda paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:15.4: musāvādā veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:16.3: ye ca pisunā vācā paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.172:16.4: pisunāya vācāya veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:17.3: ye ca pharusavācā paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.172:17.4: pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:18.3: ye ca samphappalāpa paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammo sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho.
an10.172:18.4: samphappalāpā veramaṇī paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ, gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:19.3: ye ca abhijjhāpaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:19.4: anabhijjhā paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:20.3: ye ca vyāpādapaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:20.4: avyāpāda paccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:21.3: ye ca micchādiṭṭhi paccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti ayaṃ anattho,
an10.172:21.4: sammā diṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanā pāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.172:22.1: yaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:22.2: ‘adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho,
an10.172:22.4: imassa kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi,
an10.172:22.5: ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āvuso bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha,
an10.172:22.6: yathā no bhagavā vyākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
an10.172:23.1: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhu āyasmato mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an10.172:24.1: yaṃ kho no bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho,
an10.172:24.2: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca, adhammañca viditvā dhammañca, anatthañca viditvā atthañca, yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.172:25.1: tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa bhagavato etadahosi:
an10.172:25.2: “idaṃ kho no āvuso bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho
an10.172:25.3: “adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca, anattho ca veditabbo attho ca adhammañca viditvā dhammañca anatthañca viditvā attañca yathā dhammo yathā attho
an10.172:25.5: ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyā”ti.
an10.172:26.2: “ayaṃ kho āyasmā mahā kaccāno satthuceva sammantiko sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ
an10.172:26.3: pahoti cāyasmā mahākaccāno imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
an10.172:26.4: yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkameyyāma, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ puccheyyāma
an10.172:26.5: yathā no āyasmā mahākaccāno vyākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmāti.
an10.172:27.1: atha kho mayaṃ bhante yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkamimhā. upapasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etamatthaṃ pucchimhā:
an10.172:27.2: tesaṃ no bhante āyasmatā mahākaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi vyañjanehi attho suvibhattoti.
an10.172:28.2: paṇḍito bhikkhave mahākaccāno, mahāpañño bhikkhave mahākaccāno,
an10.172:28.3: maṃ cepi tumhe bhikkhave upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ puccheyyātha ahampi cetaṃ evamevaṃ vyākareyyaṃ yathā taṃ mahākaccānena vyākataṃ.
an10.172:28.4: eso cevetassa attho, evaṃ ca naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
